2609.06212.title: SLATE: Are AI-Generated Slides Educationally Effective? A Benchmark for Language Teaching Quality and Learner Knowledge Acquisition
2609.06212.paper_summary: LLMs have achieved remarkable capabilities in generating language teaching slides. However, a critical mismatch persists between visual polish and actual instructional effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce SLATE (Slide-based Learning Assessment for Teaching Effectiveness), the first benchmark that evaluates AI-generated language teaching slides through instructional effectiveness and learner knowledge acquisition. SLATE transforms linguistics olympiad puzzles from low-resource languages with negligible web presence into 90 standardized instructional units comprising 1,133 assessable items, paired with a structured course outline and matched near- and far-transfer test sets. This pretest-posttest design eliminates pretrained knowledge leakage, ensuring gains reflect learning rather than prior recall. Using VLMs as scalable learner proxies and directionally supported by a three-system human pilot, our results show that content validity exhibits a weak association with learning gain, while pedagogical design exhibits a robust positive association. Moreover, most systems show a significant gap between near- and far-transfer accuracy, and even frontier models can produce negative learning gains. SLATE reveals a dissociation between artifact quality and instructional effectiveness, calling for a paradigm shift in how generative teaching systems are built, evaluated, and deployed.
2609.06212.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 在生成語言教學幻燈片方面已達到卓越的能力。<lb/>然而，視覺美觀與實際教學效果之間仍存在著一個關鍵的不匹配。<lb/>為了解決這一差距，我們引入了 SLATE（基於幻燈片的教學效果學習評估），這是第一個通過教學效果和學習者知識獲取來評估 AI 生成的語言教學幻燈片的基準。<lb/>SLATE 將來自低資源語言且在網路上幾乎沒有存在的語言奧林匹克謎題轉化為 90 個標準化的教學單元，包含 1,133 個可評估項目，並配有結構化的課程大綱和匹配的近轉移和遠轉移測試集。<lb/>這種前測-後測設計消除了預訓練知識的泄漏，確保增長反映學習而非先前的回憶。<lb/>使用 VLMs 作為可擴展的學習者代理，並得到三系統人類試點的方向性支持，我們的結果顯示內容有效性與學習增益之間存在微弱的關聯，而教學設計則顯示出強的正相關。此外，大多數系統在近轉移和遠轉移準確性之間顯示出顯著的差距，即使是前沿模型也可能產生負的學習增益。<lb/>SLATE 揭示了工件質量與教學效果之間的脫節，呼籲對生成教學系統的構建、評估和部署方式進行範式轉變。
